claims.text: Lisinopril 10 mg is prescribed daily in the morning.
Home blood pressure readings are around 150/90 mmHg.

open_questions: When was lisinopril first started or its dose last changed?
What were the home blood pressure readings before 2026-08-15, and how have they trended?
Was any action planned or taken in response to BP readings around 150/90?
Has lisinopril been held, stopped, or adjusted previously, and if so, why?
Which allergies or reactions are recorded?
Which follow-ups, referrals or tests are planned or outstanding?

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Home BP of 150/90 mmHg indicates uncontrolled hypertension per guideline thresholds.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Assess adequacy of current antihypertensive regimen and consider titration or add-on therapy per protocol.
